name: run-task-with-model
description: Resolve a model from the catalog and run a task in a new Codex thread.

interface.shortDescription: Run a task in a new thread with a selected model.
interface.longDescription: Reads a custom catalog or the current Codex host model catalog, resolves the requested model and reasoning level, creates a user-visible thread with a complete task packet, and preserves the acceptance and PR authorization boundary.
defaultPrompt: Use $run-task-with-model to run this feature with deepseek high.
Dispatch the current request to a new thread on gpt-5.6-sol.
Resolve a model from the local catalog and run a task in a fresh thread.
